title: Readable entity names
responsibility: Derives display names and page addresses from declared titles and ownership.

inputs.name: explorerName.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier, kind and title used for display naming.

inputs.name: explorerAppRoute.unit
inputs.description: Unit kind, title and owned files used for the page address.

outputs.name: explorerName
outputs.description: Preserves a human-written multiword title when it passes the title rules; otherwise uses route screen words, identifier words or the final identifier segment. Known initialisms stay uppercase; an empty result becomes Unnamed.

outputs.name: explorerAppRoute
outputs.description: For page or layout kinds, a slash-prefixed title or the owned +page route address; null for other kinds or no matching route file.
